name: Metal Build Hatsune Miku
description: The beloved virtual singer Hatsune Miku joins Bandai's Metal Build series!&nbsp;Building upon the alloy action figure design expertise honed within the Metal Build series, this figure features composite materials -- such as fabric costume pieces and twin-tails crafted from wire-embedded PVC sheets -- along with design arrangements that accentuate its metallic nature, and exquisite coloring that further highlights its aesthetic appeal. Thanks to its extensive and thoughtful jointing, the figure remains capable of performing a wide variety of dynamic actions even while wearing her fabric costume. An interchangeable smiling face with the eyes looking right is included; when combined with poses that take full advantage of the figure's exceptional articulation, this allows for the creation of a spirited, confident expression. An additional interchangeable face with a shouting expression, with the eyes looking left, is included too. Pair it with her acoustic gadgets to capture the high-energy atmosphere of a live concert performance!&nbsp;She also comes with a singing expression with her eyes closed; combined with her flexibly articulated PVC twin tails, it creates a scene as if a specific moment of her performance has been captured in time.&nbsp;You can extend specific sections of her heels to expand the ground contact area to enhance stability during action poses.&nbsp;The main body features a design arrangement refined through Metal Build technology. The strategic use of alloy joints with a metallic sheen throughout the figure highlights its unique appeal as the first-ever female character to join the Metal Build series!The figure's back features a mechanical design optimized for articulation, ensuring that even poses involving a deep backward arch of the torso look stunningly natural and precise.&nbsp;Thanks to hip joints constructed with multiple axes of rotation, the figure allows for extensive forward and backward bending movements centered around the waist.A dedicated display stand featuring holographic foil accents is included.&nbsp;The Metal Build Hatsune Miku is the culmination of a creative chain forged by a diverse array of creators -- order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 18cm tall [Materials]: ABS, die-cast, PVC, fabric [Set Contents]:Main figureInterchangeable faces (x4)Interchangeable hands (x4 each, left and right)Interchangeable front hair part with headdressInterchangeable twin-tail parts (left and right)Sound gadgetComplete fabric outfit setBackpack ABackpack BRight hand armorDisplay stand set

name: Hatsune Miku x Katsushika Hokusai Plushie Wave

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku MAGICAL MIRAI 2023 Ver.
description: Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2023 Ver. 1/7th Scale Figure.Step into the world of Hatsune Miku's Magical Mirai 2023 with Design COCO's latest addition - a 1/7 scale figure capturing the essence of the main visual. In this 11th iteration of Magical Mirai, the theme is HERO, and the spotlight is on the star of the event, Hatsune Miku.In a vibrant crimson costume illustrated by artist LAM, this rendition faithfully captures Miku's expression brimming with hope, and the contrast of light and shadow that make LAM's work so distinctive. Every detail, from her intense presence to the meticulously recreated shades, has been fully sculpted and painted for fans to enjoy.Adding to her allure is the inclusion of a massive speaker, with parts cleverly crafted from clear material to seamlessly incorporate optional LED lights (sold separately), granting it a cool, luminescent quality.The precision craftsmanship extends to her megaphone microphone - not only in its intricacy but also in capturing the unique color gradations akin to screen tones.Own the embodiment of a poised and cool hero Miku that appears in the nick of time!Fully Supported by the Production Committee:The main visual of Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2023, illustrated by LAM, was brought to life in full collaboration with the Magical Mirai Production Committee. Craftsmen at Design COCO breathed life into the life-sized statue exhibited at the event, paying homage to LAM's creation. In the same spirit, Design COCO, in collaboration with the Magical Mirai Production Committee, scaled down the life-sized Hatsune Miku to a 1/7 figure size. The transformation didn't involve mere scaling; meticulous adjustments were made to the 3D model to harmonize with the figure's scale, proportions, sculpting, and coloring.The Theme of Magical Mirai 2023 - HERO :The vivid red costume exudes its texture, while the embodiment of Miku's full power is expressed through precise sculpting. The distinct touch of LAM's illustration is faithfully replicated through meticulous coloring. Her gaze and expression, brimming with strength and hope, are painstakingly rendered. The result is a Miku that seems to leap out of LAM's artwork - an ultra-cool and charming representation.Precise Craftsmanship for the Megaphone Mic and Speaker:The megaphone microphone's precision craftsmanship extends to its coloring, emulating the appearance of affixed screen tones. Some parts of the giant speaker are constructed using clear material, allowing integration with separately available LED lights for a captivating cool luminosity.Cool from Every Angle:From her bright gaze, powerful costume, and stylish red and green intertwined twin tails, every angle offers an impressive view.Experience the captivating allure of Miku - the poised and cool savior who emerges when the going gets tough.Figure Size: Approximately 200mm tall (Including Base)Materials (Tentative): PVC, ABSSculptor: Design COCO (Producer: A2C)Coloring: Design COCO (Producer: A2C)Due to restrictions on this item by the manufacturer, we are unable to ship this product to China (Macau, Hong Kong and Taiwan are OK). Please note that if you place an order for this item and your shipping address is in China (Macau, Hong Kong and Taiwan are OK), your order will be cancelled.

name: 1/4 Hatsune Miku -Japanese Doll-
description: Note: Due to the high value of this item, pre-payment is required upon placing your order, and cancellations will not be accepted.FuRyu's lovely Hatsune Miku dressed in traditional Japanese clothing will captivate your heart!Miku is the 9th figure in the F:NEX Nihon Ningyou Figure lineup, and is based on a new illustration by artist Fuji Choko.The word Hatsune in Japanese culture originally refers to the sound of birds and insects, especially bush warblers, singing for the first time in the year, and we have carefully expressed the profoundness of the name in this figure.For the kimono, which is a distinctive feature of this product, the fabric for the furisode portion was repeatedly tested so that the patterns would connect to each other even across the sewing line, and gold foil stamping was applied to reproduce a glittering gold sheen.These kimonos are dyed using the traditional yuzen-dyeing technique, using molds to carefully dye one color at a time. 12 colors are used for the green kimono and 11 colors for the blue kimono, and the time and effort put into the dyeing process gives them a unique depth of color.The facial expression is faithfully reproduced from the illustrations, with jewel-like eyes that catch the light and emit a variety of sparkles, and cheeks with a hint of vermilion and cherry-red lips to create a peaceful impression.Now can have this beautiful Hatsune Miku in your hands, a figure that has been carefully crafted with all the care and attention to detail that Japanese culture and traditions demand.Product Size: 1/4 scaleHeight: approx. 410mm (excluding pedestal)Material: PVC, ABS, rayon, polyester, acetate, cardboardCostume/Dress: YoshinoriSculptor: Design COCO (Art Director:CHIGA)Color creation: B_SachiDue to the convenience of the fabric and the method of dressing, there may be individual differences in the appearance of the patterns and wrinkles on the costumes.

Here she is in see-through pink, dressed up with a sparkly stone set into her sleeve and a silvery disk (with a silvery metal lobster-claw attachment), and hung on a fabric-cord loop. She's 7cm tall, and she's glad to help keep your cell phone, portable game console, keys, or anything else easy to find!

name: Nendoroid Plus Stuffed Miku Hatsune
description: Here's a small, portable Miku Hachune who's just the right size to ride along with you in your car, or to sit on a shelf. This cuddly plush version of the world-famous Vocaloid spokesmodel is posable, thanks to an inner skeleton in her arms, legs, and even her pigtails! She's 26cm tall (standing), and every bit of her is snuggly soft and ready for a big hug--get her now!Please note that the photos shown are of a prototype; the production version may vary.

name: Nendoroid Plus Stuffed Miku Hachune
description: This cuddly plush of a shocked-looking Miku Hachune is posable, thanks to an inner skeleton in her arms, legs, and even her pigtails! She's 26cm tall, and every bit of it is snuggly soft and ready for a big hug--make her yours today!Please note that the photos shown are of a prototype; the production version may vary.

name: Gutto-Kuru Miku Ogawa Limited Color Ver. PVC
description: The Gutto-Kuru figures from CM's Corporation are proving to be fan favorites, bringing sometimes-seldom-seen characters to three-dimensional life! Now here's Miku Ogawa from Wingman in a limited color version! She's striking with light green hair, and with a bright pink triangle on her skirt. She's about 13cm tall, and a Wingman logo base is included. Only 600 pieces will be made, so quantities are limited--get yours now!Please note that the photos shown are of a prototype; the production version may vary. Also, figures such as this are mass produced and as a result some inconsistencies in finish and painting may occur; these are not considered manufacturer's defects. If you absolutely must have perfection, prepare to do some touch-up work on your own.

name: Gutto-Kuru Miku Ogawa PVC

name: figma Miku Hatsune
description: Super-popular Vocaloid character Miku Hatsune makes her action figure debut with this superb Figma offering from Max Factory! Standing 13cm tall, Miku is clad in her beautifully detailed stage outfit, and features a high level of articulation thanks to the ingenious Figma joints that allow you to recreate her lively stage poses! She comes packed with accessories that include two long onions, a microphone and mike stand, eight optional hands, an interchangeable face, and a figure display base with stand. Impressive! Please note that figures such as this are mass produced, and as a result some inconsistencies in finish and painting may occur; these are not considered manufacturer's defects. If you absolutely must have perfection, prepare to do some touch-up work on your own.

name: 1/8 Miku Hatsune PVC
description: Vocaloid mascot character Miku Hatsune now comes to fans as this gorgeously sculpted PVC rendition that's carefully finished and ready for a spotlight display in any collection! Based on one of creator Kei's original illustrations, Miku is brought to life in sharp 3D detail, from her characteristic twin tails to the hand on her headset, looking as if she's about to sing! A hexagonal display base is provided. Please note that figures such as this are mass produced and as a result some inconsistencies in finish and painting may occur; these are not considered manufacturer's defects. If you absolutely must have perfection, prepare to do some touch-up work on your own.

name: Miku Hatsune Vocaloid 2 Official Guide Book with DVD-ROM
description: From developer Yamaha Corporation comes this official how-to guide for their Vocaloid 2 Miku Hatsune computer music program for Windows XP and Windows Vista OS. Includes basic information on how to set up and use the program, input lyrics and music, create your own music, and more! Also includes a DVD-ROM that contains a 14-day trial for the Vocaloid 2 Miku Hatsune program, completed movie sample, a movie on how to use the program, and six karaoke songs in Wave format. In order to run the trial program, a computer with Windows XP/Vista OS (a Japanese version OS may be required), Pentium 4 2GHz / Athlon XP 2000+ or better CPU with 512MB or bigger RAM are required; not guaranteed to be usable outside Japan. All text is in Japanese. Softcover with dust jacket. 128 pages (64 in color).
